Unlike the MFA cluster, NCA's OWN rationale here is 'Cybersecurity enhancement', not 'Clarification' — independent confirmation that this one is a genuine strengthening (a new duty on the hosting provider to actively protect data per its classification, not just classify it before hosting), not just this project's rubric disagreeing with NCA's label.

Clean editorial case.
